summary: Universe Pharmaceuticals INC filed a Form 6-K reporting entry into a Share Purchase Agreement on June 17, 2026, to acquire 100% of Best Praise International Limited for $10,751,000, payable entirely via 4,376,552 Class A ordinary shares. The target holds five PRC patents in age-related, neurodegenerative, cognitive, and cardiovascular pharmaceutical technologies. The board ratified the deal on June 24, 2026; consideration was based on an independent valuation by King Kee Appraisal. Closing conditions include board/regulatory approvals, Nasdaq compliance, and no change of control. The deal must close within 120 days or either party may terminate; watch for patent validity and share issuance compliance risks.
